laws.name: Platform placement
laws.rule: Platforms only appear as top dropdown tab titles; never in left sidebar.

laws.name: Category placement
laws.rule: Categories only appear as dropdown list items under a Platform; never as top tabs or sidebar items.

laws.name: Feature placement
laws.rule: Features only appear in left sidebar within a Category page; never in platform dropdown.

laws.name: No empty pages
laws.rule: Every feature route must render Parameters -> Execute -> Results and at least one widget + one display.

laws.name: Shared feature duplication rules
laws.rule: If a feature appears in multiple categories, it MUST set shared_feature_key and all duplicates MUST share the same route and page_contract_ref.

laws.name: Authoritative platform order
laws.rule: Platforms must appear in this exact order: Core, Common, Audit Official Records, Automation, Settings, Admin, Workstation, Systems, Simulations, Research, Encyclopedia, Libraries, Knowledge.

ci_checks.check: Every route in router must exist in gui_nav.latest.json
Every gui_nav feature route must have a corresponding page/component file and must not render a template/blank page.
shared_feature_key duplicates must match route + page_contract_ref.
